sprint: THE DERIVATION SPRINT (V36) — THE HALT, HONORED A THIRD TIME. V35's terminal marker reads realLineageCount:0 · published:false · reachableHumans:1 · pushed:n — so V35's terminal clause binds: two pens (IN2 + PUBLICATION) have stood unmoved for two sprints, and V36 ships ZERO new product capability a third time. ONE law: X-DERIVE — NOTHING IS CLAIMED THAT IS NOT COMPUTED. The build log is the last hand-typed artifact in the system, and it is where three sprints of summary-drift have lived (V33 typed 'verify green' over a bifurcated guard; V34 over a red sub-check; V35 typed D33:SIGNABLE over a cross-check that validated ONE quantity of three, and 'binary exists' over an artifact it gitignored). The project has now discovered the same principle FOUR TIMES (the act is derived, X-RECKON; 'green' is derived, X-REACH(c); reach is structural, X-REACH(e); published is derived from the git remote, RP-4) and never generalized it — so derive the WHOLE log: the header, the gate's checkboxes, and the terminal marker are GENERATED by named functions over committed artifacts, each with a demonstrated negative. The cross-check becomes WHOLE (PSR and PBO independently checked against pre-registered tolerances, or D33 computes shut). The fresh clone promoted at D44 runs at last. The census gets a TREATMENT, not a thermometer. And the gate asks the one question left: is ORGANON a PRODUCT, or an INSTRUMENT?

xDerive.a_generatedNeverWritten: THE HEADER, THE GATE'S CHECKBOXES, AND THE TERMINAL MARKER ARE GENERATED, NEVER WRITTEN. The agent writes prose in the phase bodies; the machine writes the claims. A build log's summary is a REPORT over committed artifacts, and a report that a human types is an opinion. Rollup.{header,gate,terminalMarker}() are pure reads over committed artifacts; their OUTPUT is the log's summary. A claim in the header/gate/marker whose text is hand-typed (not emitted by a producer) is a Halt.
xDerive.b_everyClaimHasAProducer: EVERY CLAIM HAS A PRODUCER: a named function, over named committed artifacts, whose output IS the claim. A claim with no producer is not a claim — it is a sentence, and the generator strips it. The project has discovered this principle four times (the act is derived; 'green' is derived; reach is structural; published is derived from the git remote). X-DERIVE is the generalization those four were instances of.
xDerive.c_aBooleanIsComputedOrItIsFalse: A BOOLEAN IS COMPUTED OR IT IS FALSE. D50(i) 'a binary exists' := does a release artifact exist at a committed, checksummed path? D33 'SIGNABLE' := do ALL THREE cross-check quantities agree within the PRE-REGISTERED tolerance? A checkmark that a human typed FAILS the battery.
xDerive.d_everyNumberCarriesItsTier: EVERY NUMBER ABOUT THE PROJECT CARRIES ITS PROVENANCE TIER — REAL · SAMPLE · UNJUDGEABLE. X-MOAT has governed every number ORGANON displays about DeFi since Alpha. It has never governed the numbers ORGANON displays about ITSELF, and V35's un-tiered PBO=0.6 is what that costs. The moat, turned inward. A number about the project with no tier FAILS the battery (S102).
xDerive.e_partialRendersAsPartial: A PRODUCER THAT RETURNS PARTIAL RENDERS AS PARTIAL — NEVER AS COMPLETE. D33 is not SIGNABLE; it is PRECONDITION-MET-FOR-DSR-ONLY until PSR and PBO agree. The vocabulary of a claim must be able to express its own incompleteness, or it will round up.
xDerive.f_toleranceIsPreRegistered: A TOLERANCE IS PRE-REGISTERED, before the numbers are seen. The agreement threshold for every cross-checked quantity is pinned in Phase 0, content-hashed, BEFORE Phase 2 runs. Choosing a tolerance after seeing the disagreement is HARKing — and this project sells a tool that exists to catch exactly that (X-MANIFEST applied to our own engineering). CrossCheck.agreement(q) reads the tolerance from THESE pins, never from the call site; a tolerance changed after the numbers are seen is a re-pin, is disclosed, and counts as a SEARCH under X-RECKON.

preRegisteredTolerances.rule: X-DERIVE(f) — the DSR/PSR/PBO agreement tolerances, pinned and content-hashed in Phase 0 BEFORE Phase 2's cross-check executes. CrossCheck.agreement(q) reads the tolerance ONLY from here; the call site never supplies it. A number seen before its tolerance is pinned is HARKing; the tool this project sells exists to catch exactly that.
preRegisteredTolerances.rationale: Chosen a priori from the MATH, not from any observed gap. PSR and DSR: rigor.py (frozen) and purgedcv both implement Bailey & Lopez de Prado 2012 Eq.7 (sample skew + NON-excess kurtosis; the purgedcv docstring states the identical formula) — they should agree to floating-point precision, and 0.02 (2 probability points) generously absorbs BLAS/float-detail differences while rejecting any real formula divergence. PBO: rank-based CSCV over C(S,S/2) combinations; with S, the selection metric (mean/std ddof=1), the contiguous partition, and the no-purge/no-embargo setting all pinned IDENTICAL in both implementations, the estimator computes over the SAME combinations and should agree to within the granularity 1/C(8,4)=1/70≈0.0143 (at most one tie-break combo) — 0.02 absorbs one combo of convention drift and rejects any parameter-driven divergence (>0.1). DSR's 0.02 is CARRIED from V35 (already validated at |Δ|=1.2e-3); PSR's and PBO's are genuinely a priori (their agreement was UNSEEN when this tolerance was pinned).
preRegisteredTolerances.thirdValueUncomparable: RP-2 — if an implementation cannot be parameterized to the frozen module's settings (S, metric, tie-break, purge/embargo), that quantity's agreement computes UNCOMPARABLE, a THIRD value distinct from agrees:false. 'We could not compare' and 'they disagree' are different facts; X-HONEST demands the distinction. NOTE the tree shows purgedcv CAN be aligned for PBO (n_splits=8, metric=mean/std ddof=1 identical to rigor._col_sharpe, no purge/embargo, matrix transposed to (n_configs,n_obs)) — so PBO is expected COMPARABLE; UNCOMPARABLE remains representable and walled.
preRegisteredTolerances.disagreementIsAFinding: attack #7 — a |Δ|>tolerance result computes agrees:false → D33 UNSIGNABLE and is reported as the sprint's HEADLINE, never tuned away. That is a successful sprint: it means the frozen math and the independent reference disagree and someone must know before the pen moves.

censusRoutes.rule: E-5/DD-20 — the census stops being a thermometer and becomes a TREATMENT. Take >=10 of the 83 ORIGIN_UNRECORDED walls; per wall, in order, apply exactly one route. The count MUST be strictly lower and is shown before->after. Falsify.census() is extended with recovered/reFounded/deleted sub-counts, all derived from committed annotations (a living wall, RP-6).
censusRoutes.route1_recover: RECOVER — git archaeology (git log -S<test>, the introducing commit, the sprint's committed record) surfaces the ORIGINATING defect; the recovered origin is annotated in the committed test header (a W-tag / RECOVERED-ORIGIN line quoting the defect) so the pure-read census buckets it DEMONSTRATED. Counted as `recovered`.
censusRoutes.route2_reFound: RE-FOUND — if no origin is recoverable, STATE the defect this wall would catch TODAY, seed that negative, show it fails; annotated RE-FOUNDED in the committed test header. Bucketed DEMONSTRATED(re-founded) and counted as `reFounded` — a DISTINCT sub-count, forever (RP-3: a purpose reconstructed is not a purpose remembered).
censusRoutes.route3_deleteWithProof: DELETE-WITH-PROOF — only if no defensible defect exists AND removing the wall changes no other test's outcome (proven by a battery run with it removed). Disclosed as D52; the wall's source is preserved in the census record so it can be restored. Deletion is RARE and is itself a finding when it happens.
censusRoutes.rp3_recoverBeforeReFound: RP-3 (F-3, blocking) — RECOVER must be ATTEMPTED and its result RECORDED for every processed wall before RE-FOUND is permitted; the git archaeology is shown and its failure stated before route 2 opens. RE-FOUND launders ignorance into confidence if taken by reflex; the recover-first record + the distinct DEMONSTRATED(re-founded) tag are the guards. Re-founding, not deleting, is the EXPECTED outcome for most.
censusRoutes.batteryDeltaProducer: RP-4 (F-4) — a deletion shrinks the battery, and the battery count is a claim. The battery producer emits {pass, delta, added, removed, removedReason[]}; a shrinking battery with NAMED removals is honest, without them is a Halt.

walls.S100: X-DERIVE — THE LOG IS GENERATED. Every header/gate/marker claim has a PRODUCER (the claim->producer map is TOTAL — a claim with no producer FAILS); every producer has a DEMONSTRATED SEEDED NEGATIVE that is the claim's OWN INVERSION (RP-1: for d33() seed 'PBO disagrees' -> UNSIGNABLE; for Release.artifact() seed 'the artifact is absent' -> D50(i) false); a hand-typed checkmark or 'green' FAILS; a producer returning PARTIAL renders PARTIAL not complete (X-DERIVE(e)). W-DV01.

Three agreement records {quantity, ours, theirs, delta, tolerance(PRE-REGISTERED), agrees|UNCOMPARABLE} against tolerances read FROM THE PINS; Signability.d33() computed from all three; a SEEDED disagreement -> D33 computes UNSIGNABLE; the cross-check deps (purgedcv) are walled OUT of the mass path and the frozen runtime; checkFrozenSet 0 drift (not one .py byte moved); the differential + bundle byte-identical. RP-6: it proves SELF-CONTAINED, not stranger-reproducible; never simulated. W-DV04.

postImplementationRePins_partF.rule: PART F — design defects found before code, blocking re-pins for Phase 0 (the RP-1..RP-7 mechanism from V35, several of which were that sprint's most valuable corrections). findings_closed_derive asserts each holds in the shipped code.
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP1_seededNegativeIsTheClaimsInversion: CRITICAL (F-1) — X-DERIVE relocates the lie to the PRODUCERS; a generated lie is a lie with a passing test, strictly worse than hand-typed because a generated file is not read. Fix: the seeded negative for a producer must be the CLAIM'S OWN INVERSION, not an arbitrary mutation — for d33() seed 'PBO disagrees' and show UNSIGNABLE; for Release.artifact() seed 'the artifact is absent' and show D50(i) false. The claim->producer map is reviewed as the highest-value diff.
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP2_alignCscvParametersOrUncomparable: HIGH (F-2) — CSCV has free parameters (S, ranking metric, tie-break, split); a cross-check that does not first align them is two different experiments. Fix: enumerate CSCV's free parameters in BOTH implementations and pin them identical (S=8, metric=mean/std ddof=1, contiguous split, no purge/embargo, matrix transposed); if an implementation cannot be parameterized to match, that quantity computes UNCOMPARABLE (a third value distinct from disagrees). The tree shows purgedcv CAN be aligned — and it also provides PSR+PBO, so pypbo (F-2's abandonware risk) is NOT needed.
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP3_recoverBeforeReFoundCountApart: HIGH (F-3) — RE-FOUND launders ignorance into confidence if taken by reflex (the retroactive-origin problem RP-1-of-V35 was built to prevent, reintroduced as a feature). Fix: RECOVER must be attempted and RECORDED before RE-FOUND opens; a re-founded wall carries a DISTINCT tag DEMONSTRATED(re-founded), counted separately forever. A purpose reconstructed is not a purpose remembered.
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP4_batteryDeltaNamesRemovals: MEDIUM (F-4) — a shrinking battery (1559->1549) reads as a regression, and X-DERIVE will faithfully compute the lower number with no explanation. Fix: the battery producer emits {pass, delta, added, removed, removedReason[]}; a shrinking battery with named removals is honest, without them is a Halt.
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP5_computeEachOptionsCost: MEDIUM-HIGH (F-5) — D51 option (2) can be taken without running the experiment; it retroactively justifies three sprints of zero users at zero cost. Fix: the menu states each option's cost, COMPUTED. Option (2)'s cost: the kill-criterion amendment is a SEARCH incrementing trialsPerFamily in the moat, permanently and publicly; and choosing (2) formally RETIRES the Socket, the curator conversation, D42, and the entire distribution arc. An option whose consequences are not computed is an escape hatch, not a choice.
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP6_cloneProvesSelfContainedNotReproduci: MEDIUM (F-6) — a clone of the LOCAL tree proves self-contained, not stranger-reproducible (that needs the published remote, correct Bun, clean OS, no cached ~/.bun or inherited venv). Fix: the clone is explicit about what it proves and does not; 'a stranger's machine remains UNTESTED until publication' is pinned; the strongest claim is 'self-contained', and X-SHOWN(b) renders anything stronger NOT HELD.
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP7_xDeriveIsTheLastStructuralLaw: STRUCTURAL (F-7) — X-DERIVE is the first entirely inward-facing law (it governs how the project talks about itself, for an auditor who does not exist). This is the correct sprint anyway (three sprints of summary-drift is a real defect), but the last one justifiable this way. Pin the sentence: if V37 wants another law, the arc is over and the Socket ships instead.

delegatedDecisions.rule: Claude Code decides, documents, proceeds. A codebase-answerable question routed back to the Operator is a STALL. Each DD records the question, what the tree showed (files/lines/transcripts), the decision, the rationale, and the evidence as real output.
delegatedDecisions.DD17_independentPsrPbo: What independent implementation cross-checks PSR and PBO? THE TREE SHOWED: purgedcv==0.1.2 (already installed, already in requirements-crosscheck.txt) exposes probabilistic_sharpe_ratio AND probability_of_backtest_overfitting — the SAME independent oracle that gave DSR provides all three. Decision: use purgedcv for all three; pypbo (the blueprint's suggestion) is NOT needed and its abandonware risk (F-2) is dodged. Never vendor/stub/mock/reimplement; deps stay in requirements-crosscheck.txt, walled out of the mass path and the frozen runtime. Honest limit: one external reference library, not three independent ones — but rigor.py vs purgedcv independence holds for each quantity.
delegatedDecisions.DD18_datasetTierAndPboMeaning: What was the cross-check RUN ON? THE TREE SHOWED: crosscheck.py builds golden noise (seed 20260627, T=504, N=1000, true Sharpe 0) identical to selftest.py's k==0 universe. Decision: TIER = SAMPLE (synthetic seeded). PBO interpretation: under CSCV, PBO>0.5 means the selected config underperforms the median OOS more often than not — but on pure-noise input (true Sharpe 0) there is no real skill, so a PBO near 0.5-0.6 is the EXPECTED fixture value validating the estimator agrees with the reference; it means nothing about a real strategy. Say which (SAMPLE).
delegatedDecisions.DD19_freshClone: Can the agent execute a genuine fresh clone? Decision: RUN IT (owed since D44/V33, deferred three times) — git clone the local tree into an empty dir, HOME/PATH scrubbed, setup -> verify -> full battery. If it genuinely cannot run, name the blocker in one checkable sentence and SHRINK verify's convergence claim. NEVER simulate.
delegatedDecisions.DD20_censusRecover: For >=10 ORIGIN_UNRECORDED walls, can the origin be recovered from git history? Decision: three routes in order — RECOVER (git log -S -> the introducing commit -> quote the defect) -> RE-FOUND (state the defect it catches today, seed it, DEMONSTRATED(re-founded)) -> DELETE-WITH-PROOF (only if no defensible defect AND removal changes no other test; D52). Record the census count BEFORE->AFTER (it must be lower).
delegatedDecisions.DD21_releaseOneCommand: Can organon.sh release produce a distributable artifact in one command? Decision: BUILD it (binary + SHA-256 + one-line install), then COMPUTE D50(i)/(ii) — they compute RED until publication. State bun build --compile reproducibility UNVERIFIED.
delegatedDecisions.DD22_jitterSource: Which test's expect() count varied by +-3 in V34? Decision: find it (git log the Ask-differential/loop tests; run each in isolation x5), name it or state unreproducible, and pin a wall that FAILS if expect() ever differs across two runs.
delegatedDecisions.DD23_differentAuthorBaits: Can the corpus's next baits be sourced from a DIFFERENT AUTHOR? THE TREE SHOWED: .env has only GROQ_API_KEY; V35 used meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct. Decision: use a different MODEL on the same provider (openai/gpt-oss-120b — a different lab, the strongest available different author), assert authorship structurally, state whether the guard caught anything; pin the honest limit (same provider, genuinely different model). If no second model were reachable, name it and pin the wall self-graded/WEAK.
delegatedDecisions.DD24_shelveMr1AsData: Are MR1's four subjects shelvable as DATA without adding capability? Decision: YES — shelve and domain-badge them; adding four already-captured, already-classified subjects to a curated shelf adds no module/surface/screen/fact-type. Pin the distinction (MR12): the Halt forbids CAPABILITY, not owed DATA; a Halt used to defer a residue is a shield.
